character.name: Pixel art sprite sheet, anime girl character, long golden blonde hair  reaching to knees, dark black dress/coat, black boots, pale skin,  small frame, cute face with amber eyes.  Style: 16-bit RPG anime, clean pixel art, soft shading. Animations needed: - Row 1: idle (4 frames, subtle breathing/hair sway) - Row 2: talking (4 frames, slight body bounce, mouth movement implied) - Row 3: thinking (4 frames, head tilt, finger to chin) - Row 4: happy (4 frames, small jump or wave) Sprite size: 64x64px per frame, 4x4 grid = 256x256px total. Transparent background. Facing front. Clean outlines.
